title: Bounded scalar curvature and smooth extension of four-dimensional Ricci flow

abstractEnglish: We prove that a smooth Ricci flow on a closed real four-manifold extends on the same manifold through every finite time at which its scalar curvature remains uniformly bounded. This resolves the scalar-curvature extension problem in dimension four.
titleEn: Bounded scalar curvature and smooth extension of four-dimensional Ricci flow
titleZh: 有界标量曲率与四维Ricci流的光滑延拓

details.overview: 稿件研究闭实四维流形上Ricci流在标量曲率有界条件下的延拓问题。作者声称，若光滑Ricci流在某个有限时刻标量曲率保持一致有界，则流可沿同一流形光滑延拓通过该时刻，从而解决四维标量曲率延拓问题。摘要未提供证明细节、技术假设或独立审查信息。

标量曲率一致有界时，流可光滑延拓通过该时刻。
